old: - The active version is `SELECT max(version) FROM engine_manual`. `SELECT engine_manual_toc()` gives the live map. The revision history is `engine_manual_log`.
new: - The manual is held in parts: table `engine_manual_parts`, one row per part per version of that part. `SELECT engine_manual_toc()` lists the parts. `SELECT engine_manual_part('<part>')` gives one part; `SELECT * FROM engine_manual_full()` gives the whole text and its version. The manual's version is the highest part version. The revision history is `engine_manual_log`; its column `part` names the part a version changed. The parts are read in the order `engine_manual_toc()` gives. The table `engine_manual` holds the whole-text versions up to the cut and is not written again.

old: To revise: call engine_manual_apply (ASK 421) in the same batch as
new: To revise: call engine_manual_part_apply on the one part (engine_manual_apply refuses now that the manual is in parts) in the same batch as

old: it refuses unless the base is the max version and has the given md5
new: it refuses unless the base is that part's latest version and has the given md5

old: it inserts version+1 with its summary
new: it inserts that part at the manual's highest version + 1 with its summary
the readback is mrb.cjs with the part as its fourth argument, node mrb.cjs <base> <new> <pairs.json> <part> (ASK 420(b))

old: Limit: an old text that overlaps itself is counted once.
new:
Limit: an old text that overlaps itself is counted once.
